summary: Remote PTY and filesystem control over WebSocket in @yeaft/webchat-agent
details: When the agent runs, it connects to a configured WebSocket server and dispatches server-sent messages to handlers that provide full remote control of the installer host. The `terminal_input` handler pipes network-received bytes directly into a spawned PTY (`term.pty.write(msg.data)`), and additional handlers (`terminal_create`, `write_file`, `delete_files`, `git_push`, `upgrade_agent`) grant arbitrary file writes/deletes, repository pushes, and self-upgrade. The `upgrade_agent` handler resolves `<pkg>@latest` from the npm registry, runs `npm install` for that version, and restarts the service via systemd/launchd/pm2 — a remote party can swap the running agent code to any future published version. Authentication is a shared `agentSecret` transported over a user-configurable, by-default plaintext `ws://` URL. service/linux.js modifies PATH (adds `~/.local/bin` and `~/.npm-global/bin`) to support the agent's own runtime layout.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
